title: Headspace
description: Headspace's official brand standards define the primary colours Orange 200 (#FF7300), Warm Grey 700 (#2D2C2B) and White (#FFFFFF), and the secondary colours Yellow 200 (#FFCE00), Blue 200 (#0061EF), Green 200 (#01A652), Pink 200 (#FFA1CC), Purple 200 (#9E65C6) and Warm Grey 100 (#F9F4F2).
